item.description:
Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • ⌘Z undoes more. Star, mark as read or unread, Report Spam, Not Spam, and dragging conversations onto a label, Trash or Spam can all be undone, like Archive and Delete already could.
  • ⌘L for Send Later while writing a message.

Bug fixes

  • Quitting Normal Mail during the Undo Send countdown no longer loses the message. It's sent right away before the app quits.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Send with ⌘Return. The shortcut is now listed in the Message menu as Send, so it's easy to find. Press ⌘Return in any message you're writing to send it. You still get the usual few seconds to undo.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • After you change your Google password, Normal Mail now notices. A banner at the top of the message list asks you to sign in again to that account, and mail starts updating again as soon as you do. Before, the account just stopped getting new mail without saying why.
  • An account no longer disappears from the sidebar if the app starts while you're offline or signed out by Google.
